catalog_search_empty_body: Search by app, project, stage or image; compose apps also by service name.
catalog_empty_body: A project groups a product's stages, like staging and production, and each stage holds its apps.
catalog_project_no_stages: This project has no stages yet.
catalog_stage_no_apps: This stage has no apps yet.
catalog_new_project_description: Groups a product's stages. The slug goes into URLs and Swarm names, and can't be changed.
catalog_slug_hint: Up to {max} characters: a-z, 0-9 and hyphens; starts with a letter.
catalog_rename_project_description: Changes the display name. The slug {project} stays the same.
catalog_new_stage_description: An environment of the project, with its own network and variables.
catalog_new_app_description: It's created without deploying: configure it first, then deploy it.
catalog_app_kind_service_hint: A service with its image, port and healthcheck.
catalog_app_kind_compose_hint: A complete compose file, in YAML.
catalog_app_created_body: Finish configuring it before the first deploy.
catalog_delete_project_body: The project is deleted. This can't be undone.
catalog_delete_project_body_stages: It still has stages: delete its apps and stages first.
catalog_project_not_empty_body: It still has stages. Delete its apps first, then its stages.
catalog_delete_stage_body: Its variables are deleted too. This can't be undone.
catalog_delete_stage_body_apps: It still has apps: delete them first from their Settings.
catalog_stage_not_empty_body: It still has apps. Delete them first from their Settings.
catalog_error_slug_format: Up to {max} characters: a-z, 0-9 and hyphens; starts with a letter and doesn't end with a hyphen.
catalog_error_slug_reserved: “{slug}” is reserved: muelle uses it for its own networks.
catalog_error_project_taken: There's already a project with that slug.
catalog_error_stage_taken: This project already has a stage with that slug.
catalog_error_app_taken: This stage already has an app with that slug.
catalog_error_name_invisible: It can't contain invisible or control characters (nor the emoji modifier).
catalog_error_kind_mismatch: The app changed type while you were editing it: its current configuration has been loaded.
catalog_error_compose_empty: The compose file can't be empty.
catalog_error_compose_too_large: The compose file is larger than 256 KiB.
catalog_spec_image_invalid: Not a valid Docker reference: registry/repository[:tag][@sha256:…], in lowercase.
catalog_spec_health_path: Starts with / and uses only letters, digits and ._~/?=%+-
catalog_spec_volume_name: Up to 16 characters: a-z, 0-9 and hyphens; starts with a letter.
catalog_spec_volume_mount: A clean absolute path other than /, with letters, digits and ._/-
catalog_app_not_found_body: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
catalog_config_subtitle: Saving doesn't redeploy: changes stay pending until the next deploy.
catalog_config_image_description: Each deploy pins the tag to an exact digest.
catalog_config_run_description: The service has the same name as the app.
catalog_config_command_hint: Arguments are separated by spaces; quote one that contains spaces. It doesn't go through a shell.
catalog_config_health_description: Swarm runs it inside the container and only switches to the new version once it responds.
catalog_config_health_none_warning: Without a healthcheck there's no zero-downtime guarantee: Swarm considers the new version ready as soon as it starts.
catalog_config_health_req_http: No shell. The image needs wget.
catalog_config_health_req_command: No shell: to use the image's, start with sh -c.
catalog_config_health_req_none: Swarm won't check the new version.
catalog_config_volumes_description: Named volumes with the local driver.
catalog_config_volumes_empty: No volumes: the service keeps nothing between deploys.
catalog_config_volumes_note: With volumes the deploy is stop-first (a few seconds without service) and the app is pinned to one node.
catalog_config_resources_description: Per-replica limits and how long muelle waits for the service to converge.
catalog_config_saved_body: They stay pending until the next deploy.
catalog_config_no_changes: There are no changes to save.
catalog_config_stored_problem: The saved configuration has a problem in {field}: {message}
catalog_delete_app_description: Deletes the app {app}, its variables and its stack {stack}. This can't be undone.
catalog_delete_app_confirm_body: The app and its variables are deleted. This can't be undone.
catalog_compose_subtitle: Compose app. {variables} are replaced with the stage's and the app's.
catalog_compose_editor_hint: Tab indents. To leave the editor with the keyboard: Esc, then Tab.
catalog_compose_valid_body: Full validation (ports, build, networks) arrives with Phase 2.
catalog_compose_syntax_error: The YAML syntax isn't valid on this line.
catalog_compose_services_empty: No services were found in the YAML.
catalog_compose_inj_note: Whatever you already define in the compose is kept, except networks.
catalog_unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway and lose them?
catalog_error_healthcheck_shape: The healthcheck isn't valid for that type.
catalog_error_spec_shape: The configuration doesn't have the shape muelle expects.
catalog_error_slug_invalid: The slug isn't valid: a-z, 0-9 and hyphens; starts with a letter and doesn't end with a hyphen.
catalog_compose_duplicate_service: The service “{service}” is repeated: YAML doesn't allow two equal keys.
catalog_compose_editor_failed: The editor couldn't be loaded: edit the YAML as text.
